components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action with observed hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;background:var(--blue,#1264e8);color:#fff;min-height:44px;border-radius:8px;padding:11px 18px;font-family:Inter, Noto Sans Thai, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--blue,#1264e8);transition:background 0.15s;cursor:pointer}.ds-button:hover{background:#074fc5;color:#fff;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1264e8);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;background:var(--blue,#1264e8);color:#fff;min-height:44px;border-radius:8px;padding:11px 18px;font-family:Inter, Noto Sans Thai, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--blue,#1264e8);transition:background 0.15s;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;color:var(--navy,#082b46);border:1px solid #cbd8df}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#f1f6fa}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1264e8);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}

narrative.overview:
Bright, bounded listing panels sit beside a working geographic surface. Navy carries factual text and map chrome, blue marks actions and selection, and green accompanies sale or availability text. The loaded Inter and Noto Sans Thai stacks keep English and Thai within the same practical vocabulary.

Density changes by context: the explorer condenses facts for comparison, while full property and editorial pages open up the same system. Borders define resting surfaces; modest shadows identify floating controls, dialogs and the phone selection sheet. The selected source world is retained without treating a preview basemap as configured satellite imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Shared blue selection across pins, cards and detail.
White factual surfaces with navy text and fine borders.
Compact discovery; more generous standalone detail.

rules.name: Shared Selection
rules.body: Use blue for the selected property across its pin and card; retain textual and programmatic state alongside color.

rules.name: Quiet Surface
rules.body: Resting cards and panels use borders; reserve the observed soft shadows for floating controls and overlays.

dos: Do use navy for primary facts, blue for actions and selection, and green with status text.
Do retain 44px control heights and visible blue focus treatment when extending existing controls.
Do pair specific SVG amenity symbols with their text labels.
donts: Don't substitute system display fonts or text glyphs for the loaded fonts and SVG icons.
Don't remove source credits, illustrative labels, preview notices or text accompanying status colors.
Don't introduce decorative kickers or eyebrows.
